title: CSCI 589 — Undergraduate Thesis Proposal and Preparation
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Students will articulate the core components of a thesis proposal, including problem definition, methodology, and evaluation criteria.
Students will demonstrate how to integrate ACM ethical guidelines and responsible research communication standards into their proposal development.
Students will produce a structured proposal outline that aligns with supervisor requirements and academic integrity standards.
